[A170]

## Status

Complete local validation at `60c5225fe5f93209bf313c51b7a722f25f9aaa7d`, tree `64182178131d03f157fe1a4ec767edee618bc6ff`. Independent reviews and CI remain pending.

## Linked Issue / roles

Closes #372

Executor A170; manager A10; R239 internal Opus and R240 external Codex.

## Description

The round-robin AXI stream mux had no bound assertion checks. This adds simulation-only checkers bound to the real mux, a direct width-8/width-64 harness with an independent beat scoreboard and non-vacuous witnesses, and a 62-row detection campaign. The original ptp_ts leg stays unchanged; its mux is not bound. Product RTL and processor pins are unchanged.

Focused author evidence records 495 checks: 92 original, 170 width-8, 171 width-64 and 62 campaign rows. The campaign includes injected source faults, DUT mutations, reset/stall/order boundaries, an elaboration guard, and disabled-assertion/missing-bind/lost-witness controls. The guidelines document two-state, single-clock, zero-delay limits; no formal proof or timing result is claimed.

## Authoritative references

REQ-VER-01/02/04; Arm IHI0051A 2.2; Verilator v5.050; #372 decision5776353888; docs/testing/ASSERTIONS.md.

## How to get into the same state

Checkout `60c5225fe5f93209bf313c51b7a722f25f9aaa7d` and initialize `third_party/verilog-axis`, `protocol-processor` and `gptp-processor`. Use Verilator 5.050.

## How to validate

```sh
make -C tb/verilator/ptp_ts
python3 scripts/measure_test_evidence.py --check
```

Expected exit 0. The complete 45+5 local results and exact commands are in the evidence comment. [Author evidence and attribution limits](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/372).

## Known limitations / out of scope

No hardware campaign, processor-pin adoption, or broader product-compliance claim. Author-only measurements keep their original commit identity; the manager packet separately identifies the tested integration tree.

## Definition of Done

- [x] Complete local source bar and final source tree integrity
- [ ] Independent internal and external positive reviews, all five lenses clean
- [ ] Final-head local replica and required hosted contexts
- [ ] No outstanding finding or review; current candidate verified
- [ ] Authorized merge, containment, post-merge hosted checks and Closed/Done
